title: His mother teaches him piano and dance; her death
summary: Clarke was born in Pittsburgh; his pianist mother taught him piano from about five, and when she died around age six and a half he gave up music.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Well, Helen, I was born in Pittsburgh, exactly 63 years ago, and my mother was a very good pianist and she began teaching me to dance and to play the piano. She

would put me on her knee and we would play for hours and just different songs. I imagine I was about five and a half years old. And I created -- developed a love for the piano, unbelievable. And I played piano, sadly to say (Unintelligible), until my mother died, and then I was completely -- I had forgotten about music. I forgot about music completely.
How old were you when your momma died?
Well, I was about six and a half years old.
And I was just beginning to really understand the piano and rhythms and chord changes and things like that.
You might have been a piano player.
I'm sure I would have. That's sure. I have no doubt about that.
And I just gave up music altogether until I guess they put me away in a place, sort of a boarding school.
